description_en: Modifies the scrubbing thresholds for an asset that is assigned a public IP address. This operation is a synchronous operation that supports Terraform
description_zh: 修改单个公网IP资产的DDoS防护清洗阈值，该接口为同步接口，用于支持terraform
kebab_example: aliyun antiddos-public modify-ip-defense-threshold --ddos-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-type ecs --instance-id i-uf6idy3c57psf7vu0000 --internet-ip 192.0.XX.XX --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyIpDefenseThreshold

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the asset.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
公网IP资产所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html查询所有地域ID
parameters.name: ddos_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the asset. Valid values:

ecs: an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.

slb: a Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance.

eip: an elastic IP address (EIP).

ipv6: an IPv6 gateway.

swas: a simple application server.

waf: a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance of the Exclusive edition.

ga_basic: a Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.help_zh:
公网IP资产的实例类型。取值：


ecs：表示云服务器ECS实例。
slb：表示负载均衡SLB实例。
eip：表示弹性公网IP实例。
ipv6：表示IPv6网关公网实例。
swas：表示轻量服务器公网实例。
waf：表示Web应用防火墙独享实例。
ga_basic：表示全球加速公网实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354191.html operation to query the IDs of ECS instances, SLB instances, and EIPs within the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
公网IP资产的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354191.html查询当前阿里云账号拥有的ECS、SLB、EIP实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The traffic scrubbing threshold. Unit: Mbit/s. The traffic scrubbing threshold cannot exceed the peak inbound or outbound Internet traffic, whichever is larger, of the asset. When you modify Bps, Pps is required. Otherwise, Bps does not take effect.

You can use the monitoring tool that is provided by the asset to query the Internet traffic of the asset:

If the asset is an ECS instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25482.html.

If the asset is an SLB instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85982.html.

If the asset is an EIP, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85354.html
parameters.help_zh:
设置流量清洗阈值，单位：Mbps。该阈值不能超过当前实例的公网数据流量峰值。修改Bps时，Pps必填，否则不会生效。

您可以使用实例自带的监控工具，查询实例的公网数据流量：

如果您使用ECS实例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25482.html。
如果您使用SLB实例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85982.html。
如果您使用EIP实例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85354.html
parameters.name: bps

parameters.help_en:
The packet scrubbing threshold. Unit: packets per second (PPS). When you modify Pps, Bps is required. Otherwise, Pps does not take effect.

The packet scrubbing threshold cannot exceed the peak number of inbound or outbound packets, whichever is larger, of the asset. You can use the monitoring tool that is provided by the asset to query the number of packets of the asset:

If the asset is an ECS instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25482.html.

If the asset is an SLB instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85982.html.

If the asset is an EIP, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85354.html
parameters.help_zh:
设置报文数量清洗阈值，单位：pps。修改Pps时，Bps必填，否则不会生效。

该阈值不能超过当前实例的数据包流量峰值。您可以使用实例自带的监控工具，查询实例的数据包流量：

如果您使用ECS实例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25482.html。
如果您使用SLB实例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85982.html。
如果您使用EIP实例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85354.html
parameters.name: pps

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically adjust the scrubbing threshold based on the traffic load on the asset. Valid values:

true: automatically adjusts the scrubbing threshold. You do not need to configure the Bps and Pps parameters.

false: The scrubbing threshold is not automatically adjusted. You must configure the Bps and Pps parameters. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用自动设置，即根据实例的流量负载，自动调整清洗阈值。取值：
true：表示是，无需手动设置Bps、Pps参数。
false（默认值）：表示否，需要手动设置Bps、Pps参数
parameters.name: is_auto

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the asset
parameters.name: internet_ip

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
